scope: NFL Week 1 2026 fantasy-relevant intelligence through completed Monday Night Football; later news is append-only delta evidence.

themes.summary: Update fastest on snaps, routes, touches, goal-line work and personnel; shrink one-game efficiency and touchdown outcomes.
Represent early-down, passing-down, two-minute, short-yardage and goal-line duties separately rather than one RB1 share.
Infer hierarchy from routes, alignment, target concentration and personnel rather than nominal depth chart.
Track multi-TE/heavy personnel as a structural league/team feature that changes flex opportunity.
Propagate starter availability and replacement competence into pass-catcher distributions.
Same-body-part recurrence carries more risk than a generic questionable tag.
Defensive star absences and pass-rush changes feed opponent-adjustment and scoring-environment models.
Treat Week 1 play-calling changes as provisional regime signals that strengthen or decay over Weeks 2-4.
Normalize production for overtime/play volume, turnovers, defensive scores and short fields before updating offensive efficiency.
